purpose: Machine-readable delta map for the architecture change (relay removal, public console, disposable Keycloak), including the carry-forward verdict for each earlier finding and the contract contradictions that Requirements must resolve. Proposal only; closes nothing.

ownerAuthority.K-2: no maintenance commitment; disposable; rebuild with a newer release rather than repair
ownerAuthority.K-3: presenter-local relay removed entirely; presentation in the cloud; local only for tests and the test database
ownerAuthority.P-1: publicly reachable console; single demo login as the only gate; attempt rate limiting

changes.change: Relay removed; browser speaks directly to a cloud console API with only the demo OAuth token
mTLS + OAuth service identity relocated to console→ACL and ACL→processor; browser hop carries no service identity
changes.why: no local component exists to hold a certificate; service identity belongs between services

changes.change: Public console: CloudFront + private S3 (OAC) + same-origin /api → HTTP API with JWT authorizer; WAF + rate limits; CSP; no CORS
changes.residual: demo credential is the only gate; synthetic history and synthetic payment initiation are reachable by anyone holding it

changes.change: Keycloak operating model is rebuild-not-repair; no on-call, SLA, HA, backup recovery or restore rehearsal
Service clients renamed: svc-console-relay → svc-console; svc-console-ws and svc-acl retained; console-demo public client unchanged in kind
changes.why: the relay principal loses its consumer
changes.note: rotation minima from SR2-03 now apply to three service clients

changes.change: WebSocket is browser-direct; token carried in Sec-WebSocket-Protocol; exact Origin enforced; one credential instead of two
changes.why: browsers cannot set arbitrary headers on WebSocket; the relay that could is gone
changes.deltaForSecurity: identity count reduced from two to one at $connect (D-5)

changes.change: Demo token in browser memory only; refresh token in memory with rotation (recommended) or re-login; no cookie at the API
changes.why: no relay to hold server-side session state

changes.change: Version move = change image digest, recreate with a fresh database, import the realm, re-verify
changes.why: disposable model; in-place migration is not the chosen path

carryForward.note: evidence path untouched by relay removal
deny/condition strategy unchanged; also applies to console downstream invoke
relay key class disappears; minima unchanged

carryForward.reason: the relay no longer exists; capability now sits with the demo token and svc-console

carryForward.note: now applies to a browser client

contractContradictions.issue: relay/IAM-signed $connect and X-Demo-JWT no longer exist
local relay holds JWT; loopback session model
screen-share and no-public-hosting text superseded by K-3/P-1
loopback relay premise; WS realization wording
service/environment scope at connect with no service identity
rate limiting, CORS/CSP and public exposure undefined
console.write/service identity on the console hop

implementationChoices: refresh token in memory with rotation vs re-login every ≤900 s (§2.2)
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol token carriage vs one-time ticket (§3.2)
decisions.possibleEscalation: If Security rejects the single-credential socket (D-5), the options are a cloud broker (revisiting 'no relay') or HTTP-only observation.
